articles.summary: Urban Edge Properties (NYSE: UE) announced today that its Board of Trustees has declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.21 per common share. The dividend will be payable on December 31, 2026 to common shareholders of record on December 15, 2026. ABOUT URBAN EDGE PROPERTIES Urban Edge Properties is a NYSE listed real estate investment trust focused on owning, managing, acquiring, developing, and redeveloping retail real estate in urban communities, primarily in the Washington, D.C. to Boston corridor. Urban Edge owns 75 properties totaling 16.1 million square feet of gross leasable area. For additional information: Mark Langer, EVP and Chief Financial Officer 212-956-0082 Source: Urban Edge Properties
